name: Financing Agreement Item 1
definition: Describes a financing relation between two parties, for example invoice, credit, financing request, cash accounts.

ItemContext.name: Item Context
ItemContext.definition: Parameters related to the context of the item.

ItemAction.name: Item Action
ItemAction.definition: Code to indicate the action concerning the item.

PaymentInstrument.name: Payment Instrument
PaymentInstrument.definition: Desired payment instruction to be used by buyer.

Rating.name: Rating
Rating.definition: Guarantee is (to be) provided according current rating.

ReopenIndication.name: Reopen Indication
ReopenIndication.definition: Set to yes if the agreement was rejected and needs to be re-opened for arbitrage.

Guarantee.name: Guarantee
Guarantee.definition: Issuers, amounts and periods to be guaranteed. At a given date, the sum of all issuers is guaranteed, covered as specified by rank/position and excess. For each period, the maximum value at a given date is used.

RelatedGuaranteeLetter.name: Related Guarantee Letter
RelatedGuaranteeLetter.definition: Reference to the guarantee letter issued by a guarantee provider.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Free form textual information related to the agreement.
